description: Returns hiking trails (Esja, Reykjadalur, Glymur, Vatnajökull, Kerlingarfjöll, etc.) from Umhverfisstofnun WFS, Landmælingar Íslands WFS (CC BY 4.0), and OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0). Duration and ascent are only given when the source has them.
